name: Unofficial T3 Connect bridge
description: Links this environment to the official T3 Connect service, so T3 Code apps signed in to your T3 account can reach it and the store mobile app gets push notifications.
longDescription: Publishes this p0code environment to the official T3 Connect relay, mints device credentials for signed-in T3 apps, and forwards push notifications for the mobile app. Unofficial: it is built by p0code, not by the T3 Connect service.
